title: What's new in 2.4.0
summary: Reboot reasons, gateway interface diagnostics, ISP Health PDF export, and the Live View timeline.

steps.title: Why a device restarted
steps.body: When a device has rebooted, its uptime now carries the reason: firmware upgrade, power loss, or a crash. Hover or tap the uptime on a device card to see what actually happened and the evidence behind it.

steps.title: Export ISP Health as a PDF
steps.body: The full ISP Health report exports to a PDF: scores, the per-provider breakdown, and the evidence behind them. Ready to attach when you open a ticket with your ISP.

steps.title: Inspect a gateway interface
steps.body: Read-only detail straight off the gateway: interface addresses, how long a DHCP WAN lease has left, SFP transceiver readings, and the neighbors resolved on the link. Nothing here changes gateway state.

steps.title: Step back through the Live View
steps.body: Drag the timeline to any point in the past and the map shows the network as it was then, including which clients were connected at that moment.
